fusions.name: Burning Glass
fusions.desc: Focuses heat on a target up to 7 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Kindling Point
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that hits the first enemy in its path for 15 damage and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Staring at the Sun
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 35% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Caught Spark
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
